fields.description: Buttons, links and highlights.
fields.label: Primary Color

fields.description: Gradients and hover states.
fields.label: Secondary Color

fields.description: Two hex codes cannot say whether you want a light or a dark desk.
fields.label: Custom Mode

fields.description: Subtle keeps cards neutral and puts the colour in accents. Bold gives the cards the brand tone.
fields.label: Colour Strength

fields.description: Run the sidebar from the Primary colour into the Secondary one. Without it the panel is Primary shading into its own darker end, so the Secondary colour never reaches the sidebar at all. Presets keep their own hand-picked pair and are not affected.
fields.label: Gradient Sidebar

fields.description: Applies to Custom Colors only. In Theme Preset mode each preset brings its own backdrop, so this is ignored.
fields.label: Backdrop
fields.options:
Aurora
Mesh
Grain
Facets
Silk
None

fields.description: Icon-only collapses the sidebar to icons and expands it on hover.
fields.label: Sidebar Variant

fields.description: Fill the sidebar with the theme's own colour instead of the neutral surface. Text and icons switch to the contrast colour that preset already computes.
fields.label: Brand Colour Sidebar

fields.description: Draw a faint contour pattern across the lower half of the sidebar. It is cut from the sidebar's own text colour, so it follows every preset and stays legible on a light or a dark panel.
fields.label: Sidebar Texture

fields.description: Land on a Swift home page instead of the default workspace. It shows the apps this user is allowed to open, so nothing appears here that they could not already reach. Turn it off and the desk goes straight back to Frappe's own landing.
fields.label: Custom Home Page

fields.description: A whole design for the landing: each one decides the palette, which blocks appear, how they are arranged and what is painted behind them. It applies only while the landing is on screen - no other desk page is touched.
fields.label: Desk Preset
fields.options:
Aurora
Dune
Nebula
Abyss
Pulse
Horizon
Eclipse
Honeycomb

fields.description: The greeting line at the top, by time of day.
fields.label: Show Greeting

fields.description: Create New, Reports and Notifications, beside the greeting.
fields.label: Show Shortcuts

fields.description: Number Cards to show as figures across the top - sales, invoices, payments, whatever you pick. Each card is only drawn for a user who can read its doctype, and its figure is counted through the same permissions, so User Permissions (company, territory) narrow it automatically. Leave empty for no figures.
fields.label: Home Cards

fields.description: Show the Theme chip in the navbar so users can switch theme themselves.
fields.label: Enable Theme Switcher

fields.description: Ctrl+Shift+T opens the Swift command palette.
fields.label: Enable Command Palette

fields.description: F toggles focus mode, R toggles reading mode.
fields.label: Enable Focus / Reading Mode

fields.description: Draw the preset's own background behind the desk. Turn this off for a plain, flat background.
fields.label: Enable Backdrops

fields.description: Let the background show through cards, the sidebar and table headers instead of being hidden behind them.
fields.label: Show Backdrop Through Panels

fields.description: Used when the viewer is in dark mode. Falls back to Brand Logo.
fields.label: Brand Logo (Dark)

fields.description: Shown under the login heading.
fields.label: Login Tagline

fields.description: The panel beside the sign-in form. Turn it off for a plain, centred form.
fields.label: Show Brand Panel

fields.description: One line per row. Each row becomes its own line in the heading.
fields.label: Heading
